svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" pages="3" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="main" id="8vRMg3rPNvjT32dI4wGg"> <mxGraphModel dx="3463" dy="2274" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1600" pageHeight="1600" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
autonumber

title Traffic Perception & Acquisition

actor \"Video Stream Input (Lane_idx)\" as RTSP
participant \"StreamWorker [lane_idx]\" as WRK
queue \"Frame Queue [lane_idx]\" as Q
participant InferenceEngine as ENG
participant TrafficAnalyzer as ANZ
participant OpenCVLaneViewer as MLV
participant SnapshotPublisher as PUB
queue \"SnapshotQueue\" as EXT
participant HealthMonitor as HR
actor LaunchManager as LCM
participant Logger as LOG
participant LogAnalyzer as LAna
actor Manager as User


note over RTSP, EXT: [Asynchronous Hybrid Pipeline Architecture - CPU Round-Robin Inference]

' =========================================================================
' == TẦNG PRODUCER: VÒNG LẶP ĐỚP HÌNH VÀ NẠP QUEUE (CHẠY ĐỘC LẬP THEO LÀN) ==
' =========================================================================
par lane_idx == 0
 loop while frameCaptureTimer_ms % 15 == 0
 activate RTSP
 WRK ->> RTSP: captureFrame()
 deactivate RTSP
 
 activate WRK
 note over WRK: Generate t_start & pack into frameData\n(LaneID, RawFrame, t_start)
 
 WRK ->> Q: enqueue(frameData)
 deactivate WRK
 activate Q
 note over Q: Size = 1 (Overwrite oldest frame\nto maintain freshness on CPU)
 deactivate Q
end
else lane_idx == 1
 loop while frameCaptureTimer_ms % 15 == 0
 activate RTSP
 RTSP ->> WRK: captureFrame()
 deactivate RTSP
 
 activate WRK 
 WRK ->> Q: enqueue(frameData)
 deactivate WRK
 activate Q
 deactivate Q
 end
else lane_idx == 2
 loop while frameCaptureTimer_ms % 15 == 0
 activate RTSP
 RTSP ->> WRK: captureFrame()
 deactivate RTSP
 
 activate WRK 
 WRK ->> Q: enqueue(frameData)
 deactivate WRK
 activate Q
 deactivate Q
 end
else lane_idx == 3
 loop while frameCaptureTimer_ms % 15 == 0
 activate RTSP
 RTSP ->> WRK: captureFrame()
 deactivate RTSP
 
 activate WRK 
 WRK ->> Q: enqueue(frameData)
 deactivate WRK
 activate Q
 end
end


' =========================================================================
' == TẦNG CONSUMER: ENGINE AI CHẠY VÒNG LẶP QUÉT VÒNG TRÒN 4 QUEUE ==
' =========================================================================
loop while running == true
ENG -> Q: dequeue()
activate ENG

alt Queue [lane_dx] has data (Frame available)
 Q --> ENG: allFrameData
 deactivate Q

 ENG ->> HR: sendStartExecutionSignal
 activate HR
 
 ENG -> ENG: executeInference()
 activate ENG
 note over ENG: Append t_infer to FrameMetadata
 deactivate ENG

 ENG ->> ANZ: forwardDetections(detectionData)
 deactivate ENG
 activate ANZ

 ANZ -> ANZ: trackAndAnalyze()
 activate ANZ
 note over ANZ: Append t_analyze to FrameMetadata\nand draw annotations to Frame
 deactivate ANZ

 ' ---- TẦNG UI VISUALIZATION: Cập nhật giao diện đa làn ----
 ANZ ->> MLV: updateLaneView(laneId, annotatedFrame)
 activate MLV
 alt updateLaneView SUCCESS
 note over MLV: Refresh 2x2 grid window\nvia cv::imshow()
 activate User
 MLV ->> User: showLaneView(laneID)
 deactivate MLV
 deactivate User

 activate PUB
 ANZ ->> PUB: forwardLaneMetrics(laneMetrics)
 deactivate ANZ
 deactivate PUB
 else updateLaneView FAILED
 MLV ->> LOG: logError(errorCtx)
 activate MLV
 activate LOG
 LOG -->> User: Error Log
 activate User
 deactivate LOG
 MLV ->> User: showError(errorCtx)
 deactivate MLV
 deactivate User
 end
else Queue [lane_idx] is empty (No new frame)
 Q -->> ENG: null / skip
 activate Q
 deactivate Q
 activate ENG
 deactivate ENG 
end

PUB ->> EXT: broadcastSnapshot(trafficSnapshot)
activate PUB
activate EXT
deactivate EXT

' ---- TẦNG TELEMETRY: Thu thập Metric ----

PUB ->> PUB: calculateTelemetryMetadata(Status: SUCCESS)
 activate PUB
 deactivate PUB
note over PUB: Compute End-to-End Latency\n& Formulate Metric Struct
PUB ->> LOG: logs(TelemetryData)
activate LOG
LOG ->> LOG: store(TelemetryData)
 activate LOG
 deactivate LOG 
deactivate LOG 
PUB ->> HR: sendEndExecutionSignal
deactivate PUB
HR ->> LCM: AliveNotification
deactivate HR

opt not in RT hot path
 activate LOG
 LOG ->> LOG: dumpLog()
 activate LOG
 deactivate LOG
 activate LAna
 LAna -> LOG: getLog()
 LOG -->> LAna: Logs
 deactivate LOG
 LAna ->> LAna: analyze()
 activate LAna
 deactivate LAna
 LAna -->> User: analyzedData
 deactivate LAna
end
end

id="wXhUrOOsDCytNieNQsu0" name="error"> <mxGraphModel dx="2204" dy="1447" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
autonumber

title Traffic Perception & Acquisition - Full Error Propagation Paths

participant \"StreamWorker [lane]\" as WRK
queue \"Frame Queue [lane]\" as Q
participant InferenceEngine as ENG
participant TrafficAnalyzer as ANZ
participant SnapshotPublisher as PUB
participant Logger as LOG
actor Manager as User

alt SCENARIO 1: INPUT/INGESTION ERROR (RTSP STREAM DROP / CORRUPTED FRAME)
 note over WRK: [Unified Downstream Error Propagation Pipeline Architecture]
 note over WRK: Stream Capture Timeout\nor Empty Frame Detected!
 activate WRK
 WRK -> WRK ++: Create Fake/Tombstone FrameData\nMark Status = ERR_STREAM_DROP
 return

 WRK ->> Q: enqueue(failedFrameData)
 deactivate WRK
 activate Q

 ENG -> Q: dequeue()
 activate ENG
 Q -->> ENG: failedFrameData
 deactivate Q

 opt Status == ERR_STREAM_DROP
 note over ENG: Bypass GPU Inference Execution
 ENG ->> ANZ: forwardDetections(failedFrameData)
 deactivate ENG
 activate ANZ
 end

 
 note over ANZ: Status == ERR_STREAM_DROP\nBypass Tracking & Analysis
 ANZ ->> PUB: forwardLaneMetrics(failedFrameData)
 deactivate ANZ
 activate PUB

 note over PUB: Skip broadcasting to Module 2\nExtract Error Context: STREAM_DROP

 PUB ->> PUB: calculateTelemetryMetadata(Status: ERR_STREAM_DROP)
 activate PUB
 deactivate PUB

 note over PUB: Increment Drop-Frame Rate
 PUB -> LOG: logError(STREAM_DOWN, LaneID)
 activate LOG
 deactivate PUB
 LOG -->> User: Error Log
 activate User
 deactivate LOG
 deactivate User


' =====================================================================

else SCENARIO 2: CORE AI ERROR (INFERENCE TIMEOUT / GPU OUT OF MEMORY)

 note over WRK: Ingestion Success (Happy Path Entry)
 activate WRK
 WRK ->> Q: enqueue(validFrameData)
 deactivate WRK
 activate Q

 ENG -> Q: dequeue()
 activate ENG
 Q -->> ENG: validFrameData
 deactivate Q

 opt Execution Fault
 note over ENG: AI Model Timeout / GPU OOM detected!\nModify FrameMetadata.Status = ERR_INFERENCE_TIMEOUT
 ENG ->> ANZ: forwardDetections(failedFrameData)
 deactivate ENG
 activate ANZ
 end

 opt Status == ERR_INFERENCE_TIMEOUT
 note over ANZ: Bypass Tracking & Analysis
 ANZ ->> PUB: forwardLaneMetrics(failedFrameData)
 deactivate ANZ
 activate PUB
 end

 note over PUB: Skip broadcasting to Module 2
 
 PUB ->> PUB: calculateTelemetryMetadata(Status: ERR_INFERENCE_TIMEOUT)
 activate PUB
 deactivate PUB
 note over PUB, LOG: Log GPU Metrics & Error State
 PUB ->> LOG: logError(INFERENCE_TIMEOUT)
 activate LOG
 deactivate PUB
 LOG -->> User: Error Log
 activate User
 deactivate LOG
 deactivate User
 
end

@enduml",
 "config": null

id="EqUwnukwaSoHSukEjMQe" name="watchdog"> <mxGraphModel grid="1" page="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml
autonumber

title StreamWatchdog

participant StreamWatchdog as WDG
participant \"StreamWorker [lane]\" as WRK

note over WDG, WRK: [Asynchronous Background Loop for 4 Streams]

' Kích hoạt thanh dọc cho Watchdog vì nó là Background Thread chạy suốt cuộc chơi
activate WDG

loop while checkHealthTimer_ms % 5 == 0
loop for lane in lanes (0..4)
 ' Watchdog chủ động gọi hàm check sức khỏe của Worker làn i
 WDG -> WRK: checkHealth()
 activate WRK 
 
 alt Worker [lane] is Active
 ' Trả về trạng thái OK, tắt lifeline của Worker
 WRK -->> WDG: returnHealthStatus(STATUS_OK)
 deactivate WRK
 else Worker [lane] is Frozen
 ' Trả về trạng thái lỗi / timeout
 WRK -->> WDG: returnHealthStatus(STATUS_CRITICAL)
 activate WRK 
 
 ' Watchdog ra lệnh restart đích danh Worker làn i
 WDG ->> WRK: restartStream()
 deactivate WRK
 note over WRK: StreamWorker [i] resets buffer\n& reconnects its RTSP URL
 end
end
end

@enduml
